problem_text:
A logistics coordinator is assembling a shipment of specialized components to maximize total utility points while staying within a cargo plane’s weight allowance.

The components available are:
* Component A: weight 32kg, utility 254 points
* Component B: weight 16kg, utility 66 points
* Component C: weight 9kg, utility 86 points
* Component D: weight 47kg, utility 148 points
* Component E: weight 50kg, utility 172 points
* Component F: weight 9kg, utility 31 points
* Component G: weight 37kg, utility 266 points
* Component H: weight 25kg, utility 94 points
* Component I: weight 25kg, utility 247 points
* Component J: weight 3kg, utility 141 points
* Component K: weight 30kg, utility 198 points
* Component L: weight 41kg, utility 166 points
* Component M: weight 25kg, utility 231 points
* Component N: weight 34kg, utility 43 points
* Component O: weight 27kg, utility 250 points
* Component P: weight 48kg, utility 165 points
* Component Q: weight 16kg, utility 19 points
* Component R: weight 27kg, utility 160 points
* Component S: weight 39kg, utility 239 points
* Component T: weight 37kg, utility 257 points
* Component U: weight 25kg, utility 179 points
* Component V: weight 47kg, utility 189 points
* Component W: weight 39kg, utility 75 points
* Component X: weight 23kg, utility 167 points
* Component Y: weight 37kg, utility 245 points
* Component Z: weight 10kg, utility 275 points
* Component AA: weight 14kg, utility 167 points
* Component AB: weight 6kg, utility 244 points
* Component AC: weight 9kg, utility 138 points
* Component AD: weight 8kg, utility 94 points

Furthermore, due to compatibility requirements, exactly one of Component A and Component B must be included in the shipment.

If Component C is selected, the available cargo capacity is effectively diminished by 10 kg.
The aircraft’s maximum payload is 556 kg. The coordinator must determine the optimal selection of components.
